description: This file defines a Language controller class within the Opencart admin startup namespace. It manages loading and setting language configurations based on cookies, defaults, and extensions, with methods for initializing language settings and updating language data after route processing.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the language settings within the admin startup process of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings based on available languages, cookies, and default configuration, loading necessary language files and setting language IDs.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Modifies language data after a route is processed, ensuring the correct language files are loaded based on the route and language code.
